messages.subject: [IT] Document management system – planned maintenance Sat 19 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system (FileSite) will be unavailable this Saturday 19 April from 07:00 to 11:00 BST for scheduled maintenance. Please check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and calendar are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
